[[Villnar's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Villnar Painforge]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Curses]])
:Halves casting time of [[Curses]] spells (20% chance)
:Reduces [[Bleeding]] duration on you by 20%
:[[Health]] +30

== Replica ==
This staff cannot be replicated for several reasons:
* It effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Aptitude Not Attitude" and "Fear Cuts Deeper."
* "Fear Cuts Deeper" is only available as an [[off-hand]] inscription. 
* It lacks the inherent 20% [[HSR]] that is present on all fully modifiable staves, except [[Envoy Staff]].

== Notes ==
* Only three other staves have two inscriptions and are missing a HSR 20% mod: [[Brohn's Staff]], [[Gorrel's Staff]] and [[Heleyne's Insight]].
